subject: Memory problem? (Abort on large dataset, but sub-dataset works)

messages.author: e7cc390b005447b3
messages.subject: Memory problem? (Abort on large dataset, but sub-dataset works)
parts:
Hello inla-users,

When I try estimating a model using the whole of a dataset, inla does NOT work.

However, when I try estimating the model using a small subsample it does work!

The error message in the first case is 

inla.mkl: smtp-pardiso.c:757: GMRFLib_pardiso_solve_core: Assertion `store->pstore->done_with_chol == GMRFLib_TRUE' failed.
Aborted

Can this be solved?

Best regards

Fredrik

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Memory problem? (Abort on large dataset, but sub-dataset works)
parts:
if you mean by 'does NOT work' that you do not have enough RAM to run
it, then I agree.

there are strategies to reduce the RAM used, like reducing the number of
threads

num.threads="4:-1"

but this one would be the most important one:

control.inla=list(strategy="adaptive", int.strategy="eb")


and do not use control.compute=list(config=T)


Let me know how this goes

Best
H

Yes, its likely a RAM issue

although 120Gb seems a lot, you have to look at it as RAM pr core, and
reducing the number of cores will reduce the ammount of RAM needed.

set

num.threads="4:-1"

for example, to check.
